description: Estimates IFTA fuel tax owed or credited per jurisdiction for a quarter using official 3Q2026 rates. Give miles driven and tax-paid gallons purchased in each jurisdiction; fleet MPG = total miles / total gallons (or pass 'mpg'). Taxable gallons = miles / MPG; net = taxable - purchased; surcharges (e.g. KY, VA) apply to all taxable gallons. Cite the returned link.

jurisdictions.description: One entry per jurisdiction driven in or fueled in during the quarter.

gallons.description: Tax-paid gallons purchased in the jurisdiction (0 if none).

miles.description: Total (taxable) miles driven in the jurisdiction.

mpg.description: Optional fleet MPG. Default: total miles / total gallons entered.

name: calculate_ifta
title: Estimate an IFTA quarterly return
